item.title: Miami-Dade Vibe Check: Monday, October 12
item.description: A pocketbook Monday: the county raises bus and Metrorail fares 50 cents while Metromover stays free, the Sheriff disputes a record budget, and Angie Nixon campaigns in Sweetwater. Plus disabled-parking permit cancellations, school vouchers, the weekend after Hurricane Isaias, and what Amendment 3 would cost the county.

item.description: A short test episode. Weekday episodes start Monday at 8 am.
